title: Chapter 255
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

Suddenly, within a two-kilometer radius, all the corpses floated out of the gray fog and gathered on Hella's body.

Hila suddenly opened her eyes, but her pupils were no longer dark red. Instead, they were a deep gray. The sound of bones cracking could be heard from her body, and her injuries began to heal. In just a few breaths, the broken bones were basically fixed, and the shocking wound on her abdomen closed and formed a scab.

"Ha, not dead!" Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised.

Looking at this scene, isn't this the legendary undying cockroach's little universe? What can't kill me makes me stronger, just like the close combat mage Gandalf who directly leveled up to a white robe after narrowly escaping death.

As expected of the future Goddess of Death, use your peerless skill, sister!

Hella sat up, and the gray fog dissipated, and her pupils returned to normal. She coughed violently and was extremely weak. "Go, don't worry about me, my condition is too bad."

Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

Damn, so she didn't use her peerless skill after making such a big commotion? Isn't this just a joke? I was happy for nothing, you're too weak!

"Oh right, I remember that she has a special ability called [Ignore Instant Death], which allows her to gain a special status when her HP is lower than 1%. I thought it was an attack that ignored instant death, but it turns out that it's a recovery from near death. Her vitality is really tenacious, this ability must have a cooldown limit." Han Xiao thought to himself.

He was surrounded by enemies, and his condition was not good. Hella had also become a burden, and her situation was extremely bad.

"Didn't you say that you would abandon me when necessary? Now is the time, hurry up and go!" Hella's face was pale, and she used all her strength to force the words out from between her teeth. She pressed her palms on Han Xiao's chest, trying to push him away.

"Okay." Han Xiao nodded decisively. He was not the kind of person who was wishy-washy. This was the best choice in front of him, and there was no point in staying. He would not make such a futile choice.

Even if Hella was a potential stock that he wanted to win over, if necessary, he would not hesitate to give up Hella.

Seeing that Han Xiao didn't waste any time, Hella heaved a sigh of relief. "I'll leave my sister to …"

However, at this moment, a strange voice sounded from Han Xiao's communicator.

"Hey, I see you guys. Wait for me!"

Han Xiaoxin sensed something and looked to the south, only to see three black, unmarked heavy armored off-road vehicles appear at the side of the battlefield, driving at high speed in a triangle formation.

The Germinal Organization's military helicopters flew over and welcomed the group of uninvited guests. Han Xiao zoomed in and saw the window of the off-road vehicle in the front rolling down. A pale female hand reached out, wearing a string of red pearls on her wrist.

The next moment, a raging flame ignited in his palm out of thin air, instantly turning into a roaring flame dragon that swept across the sky, turning several armed helicopters into exploding balls of fire.

Boom!

The helicopter fell.

Three cars drove past the burning wreckage.

"The reinforcements are here!" Han Xiao felt as if a huge rock had been lifted from his heart. He patted Hella's face and smiled. "Looks like you don't have to stay and wait for your death."

The reinforcements were all elites selected by the Six Nations. They were all superhumans, and they were all well-equipped.

The three heavy armored off-road vehicles rampaged into the battlefield, tearing apart the encirclement of the Germinal Organization's troops. The female Esper who could control flames wantonly unleashed a sea of flames.

This was not a simple flame, but a special flame born from energy. Once it hit the target, it would explode. It was called Explosive Flame, and it was one of the more powerful types of flame Espers.

With just one look, Han Xiao could tell that this woman was a grade C Esper.

The Germinal Organization's troops were preparing to turn their muzzles, but the three heavy armored off-road vehicles spat out smoke at the same time, quickly filling half of the battlefield and obscuring their vision.

The Germinal Organization's troops suddenly lost their target, and they could not even see their comrades. They could only see less than one meter.

Coughing sounds could be heard in the thick smoke, and the smoke contained irritating components similar to tear gas.

"Where is the enemy? I can't see, cough cough — "

"It's too choking, cough cough."

"A new enemy has appeared, requesting instructions, blargh, requesting instructions!"

"Radar is disrupted, the enemy has electromagnetic interference!"

The Germinal Organization's troops were in a mess, and the four veteran officers made a prompt decision. They followed the memory before their vision was obstructed and ran toward the most important target, Han Xiao, but found that Han Xiao was no longer at the same spot.

"Oh no, he's running away!" Jeross was shocked. "Who can sense his location?"

The three Martial Artists stared at each other in bewilderment.
